title: Letermovir (LMV) prophylaxis in CMV-seronegative Allogeneic Stem Cell Transplant Recipients with CMV seropositive donors
official: Letermovir (LMV) prophylaxis in CMV-seronegative Allogeneic Stem Cell Transplant Recipients with CMV seropositive donors: an exploratory study from Spanish GETH/TC Centers
summary: Main objective: To determinate the incidence of csCMV infection through week 14 post-SCT.
conditions: Cytomegalovirus infection in allogeneic stem cell transplant recipients
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥18 years
2. First allogenic HCT.
3. Pre-HCT patient CMV negative IgG serology with CMV IgG positive donor serostatus.
4. Able to provide written consent and complete the informed consent.
5. Absence of CMV DNAemia requiring antiviral therapy within 5 days before initiation of LMV.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Active pre-emptive therapy for csCMV-I.
2. History of current evidence of any condition, therapy, lab abnormality, or other circumstance that might confound the results of the study, interfere with the subject's participation for the full duration of the study, or would place the subject at undue risk as judged by the investigator, such that it is not in the best interest of the subject to participate in this study.
3. Patients who have received LMV prophylaxis prior to enrollment.
4. Glomerular filtration rate (GFR) </=30 mL/min/1.73m^2 (equivalent to creatinine clearance (ClCr) </=10 mL/min).
5. Severe hepatic function grade 3-4 CTAE at the time of study entry.
6. Suspected or known hypersensitivity to active or inactive ingredients of LMV formulations.
7. History of allergic reactions attributed to compounds of similar chemical or biologic composition to LMV
8. Patients with previous untreated reactivation.
9. Pregnancy or breastfeeding.
10. Plans to conceive or father children within the projected duration of the trial.
sponsor: Grupo Espanol De Trasplante Hematopoyetico Y Terapia Celular
